source_citation: Re-authored per the VALIDATOR findings and the recovery reconciliation. Corrected citations verified against the actual edition texts: BPHS ch. 32 v. 31-34 (House Significance — the significator of each house, incl. Jupiter for the 5th/9th and Venus for the 7th) and BPHS ch. 20 v. 1-2 (Jupiter in the 9th house confers fortune). brihat-jataka.seventh-lord.4 and prasna-marga.chandra-venus.5 are INACTIVE (NEEDS-RESEARCH) pending committed reference excerpts. VALIDATOR re-check (2026-08-13): karaka.jupiter.1 conclusion completed to the full significator set (2nd/5th/9th/11th) per BPHS ch. 32 v. 31-34; bhava-9.3 conclusion scoped explicitly to the Jupiter-placement component per BPHS ch. 20 v. 1-2.

entries.summary: Jupiter is the karaka of the 2nd, 5th, 9th and 11th houses

conclusion.statement: Jupiter is the karaka (significator) of the 2nd (wealth), 5th (progeny), 9th (fortune) and 11th (gains) houses (BPHS ch. 32 v. 31-34).

entries.summary: Venus is the karaka of the 7th house (wife, marriage)

conclusion.statement: Venus is the karaka (significator) of the 7th house (wife, conjugal bliss) (BPHS ch. 32 v. 31-34).

entries.summary: Jupiter occupying the 9th house is read for fortune

conclusion.statement: Should Jupiter be in the 9th house, fortune is indicated (BPHS ch. 20 v. 1-2; the verse's 'extremely fortunate' also requires the 9th lord in an angle and a strong ascendant lord).
